Description of the accident (claimant's words)
I was driving home along the right-hand lane when I signaled and began moving left to pass a slower vehicle. As I
checked my mirror and moved over, another car came up in the adjacent lane and its side brushed against the front
passenger corner of my vehicle. The impact pushed my car toward the median, and I had to brake hard to regain
control. Four of us were inside at the time, and everyone felt the jolt. My passenger in the front seat hit her shoulder
on the door frame, the person behind me pressed against the seatbelt, and I felt sharp pain in my neck and back. We
all got out of the car and waited for the police to arrive. The incident took place on 10-23-24 in Baytown, during the
evening commute, in clear weather with normal traffic flow.
